name: DNA
oneLine: The cell’s archive: a double strand that stores every gene.
howItWorks: DNA is like RNA, but with two strands wound together. Each strand backs up the other. That makes it more stable, so it is better for long-term storage.
deeper: In the minimal cell the DNA is one loop of about 531,000 letter pairs. Stretched out, it would be about 180 µm long, much wider than the cell.
sizeComparison: a 50,000th the width of a hair
simplification: The loop is shown short and uncoiled. Real DNA is tightly packed.
